result.title: Dino Forcing Flow Models: Do not denoise what you can predict
result.summary: Co-denoising pretrained representations such as DINO can substantially improve the training speed and quality of flow matching models, but it introduces a second denoising trajectory and requires carefully designed schedules. We propose a simpler alternative: predict the pretrained representation directly, then condition the model on its own prediction. This removes the need for a second ODE and any representation-specific denoising schedules, while retaining the benefits of representation guidance. Our approach converges substantially faster and achieves better generation quality as measured by FID score. On ImageNet, it outperforms the state of the art in latent space at 2x fewer epochs than prior methods; in pixel space, it improves FID over comparable prior methods by more than 20%. These results support a simple principle: do not denoise what you can predict. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/arijit-hub/dino_forcing.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Dino Forcing：不再对预训练 DINO 表示做共同去噪，而是直接预测该表示并以模型自身的预测作为条件，从而省去第二条 ODE 与表示相关的去噪调度，在 ImageNet 上更快收敛并取得更好 FID。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预测预训练表示并以自身预测自条件」的机制可能为 LVR 中把预测的视觉表示当作推理状态、避免对 latent 反复去噪提供方法线索，但是否适用于推理期状态生成尚待核查。
